title: Cant get the rod to adjust
text: Cant get the rod to adjust. I didn't like the fact that I turned it to it's longest length and it is stuck there. I will have to use vise-grips and pliers to loose the two pieces, This was totally unexpected. I will probably damage it trying to move the inner and outer rod but I have no choice. Wouldn't recommend. If you do try it. don'y unscrew it too far. The finish is smooth and nice but if I can't use i.. that doesn't matter to me.

product_metadata.title: Zenna Home Tension Stall Shower Rod, 27"-40", White
features: MADE FOR SMALLER SHOWERS: Adjusts to fit any standard stall shower space (from 27 to 40 inches)
EASY TO INSTALL: Just extend rod to wall and twist to tighten
NO TOOLS NEEDED: No drilling and no damage to walls, thanks to innovative TwistTight tension mount mechanism
HOLDS STRONG: Use with any standard shower curtains and liners; holds strong in your shower
ATTRACTIVE AND RUST RESISTANT: White finish fits in with any bath décor and resists rust; includes non-marring end caps to protect bathroom walls
description: It's easy to upgrade the look and feel of your stall shower space with the Zenna Home Adjustable Tension Shower Rod. Made specifically for smaller shower areas, this shower rod adjusts (without cutting) to fit in any standard stall-sized space from 26 to 40 inches. Thanks to its innovative TwistTight mechanism, installation is easy, secure and tool free. Just extend the rod to the wall, and twist to tighten in place. The rod holds up to 30 pounds and can be used with any shower curtains, liners and hooks or rings. Its white finish is attractive and rust resistant.
